message.content: Starting the hunt with broad random sweeps to map the failure landscape.
Random probing caught an all-red clearance failure — now shrinking it to a minimal case.
Shrunk to a compact emergency-triggered case; I'll verify it replays and inspect the violation.
Replay confirmed the trace — now inspecting the signals around the failure.
First violation is NS going green during an emergency — I'll trace the steps leading into it.
Ledger tracks emergency preemption as the open hypothesis. Gathering pre-violation states to confirm.
Seen EW yellow collapsing straight to NS green. Checking earlier steps to time the emergency onset.
The pattern points to emergency preemption cutting the transition short — testing that by removing it.
Counterfactual without the emergency runs clean. Submitting the grounded violation report.
